meta.name: watch
meta.description: Start (or stop) the nyann CI sentinel for the current repo, OR manage a multi-repo watch-list and poll all watched repos at once. The sentinel polls open PRs for state transitions (CI failure, approval, merge, branch staleness) and emits notifications the session-start hook surfaces on your next prompt. TRIGGER when the user says "watch this PR", "watch my PRs", "ping me when CI passes", "tell me when CI fails", "background watch", "keep watching after I close this", "run the sentinel in the background", "daemonize the watcher", "watch in the background", "/nyann:watch", "/nyann:watch --pr <N>", "/nyann:watch --daemon", "stop watching", "/nyann:watch --stop". ALSO TRIGGER for multi-repo aggregation: "watch all my repos", "watch across repos", "add a repo to my watch list", "add <owner/repo> to watch", "remove <owner/repo> from watch", "list watched repos", "what's new across all my repos", "poll every repo I'm watching", "/nyann:watch --add", "/nyann:watch --remove", "/nyann:watch --list". Do NOT trigger on "
